items.title: Easy Cabinet: Wardrobes
items.author: Bashi
items.text: New Wardrobe catalog with hinged, sliding, open and corner wardrobes.
items.html:
The Wardrobe catalog is here. Choose it in Models, then pick a unit in the Tall category.

What is new

  • Hinged wardrobes with 2, 3 or 4 doors
  • Sliding wardrobes with 2 or 3 doors on two tracks
  • Open wardrobes and a corner L wardrobe
  • Dividers and a hanging rail you set in the panel

Read the guide for the details.
